Estimate Momentum measures change in analyst sentiment over time and may be an indicator of future price movements. The Change in Consensus chart shows the current, 1 week ago, and 1 month ago consensus earnings per share (EPS*) forecasts.
 For the fiscal quarter endingSep 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has decreased over the past week from 3.93 to 3.92(0.25%) and increased over the past month from 3.78 to 3.92(3.70%). Of the 2 analysts making quarterly forecasts, 1raised and 1 lowered their forecast.
 For the fiscal year ending Dec 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has remained the same over the past week at 12.52 and increased over the past month from 11.93 to 12.52(4.95%). Of the 3 analysts making yearly forecasts, 3raised and none lowered their forecast.
